1.english_reference: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Ἰωσαφὰτ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Dormívit autem Iósaphat cum pátribus suis ,
traditions.KJV: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers ,

1.english_reference: and was buried with his fathers in the city of David

traditions.WLC: ו וַ יִּקָּבֵ֥ר עִם אֲבֹתָ֖י ו בְּ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν πόλει Δαυείδ ·
traditions.VUL: et sepúltus est cum eis in civitáte David :
traditions.KJV: and was buried with his fathers in the city of David .

1.english_reference: And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹרָ֥ם בְּנ֖ וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ἰωρὰμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ᾽ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: regnavítque Ioram fílius eius pro eo .
traditions.KJV: And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead .

2.english_reference: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat

traditions.WLC: וְ לֽ וֹ אַחִ֞ים בְּנֵ֣י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐτῷ ἀδελφοὶ υἱοὶ Ἰωσαφὰτ ἕξ ,
traditions.VUL: Qui hábuit fratres fílios Iósaphat ,
traditions.KJV: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat ,

2.english_reference: Azariah , and Jehiel , and Zechariah , and Azariah , and Michael , and Shephatiah

traditions.WLC: עֲזַרְיָ֤ה וִֽ יחִיאֵל֙ וּ זְכַרְיָ֣הוּ וַ עֲזַרְיָ֔הוּ וּ מִיכָאֵ֖ל וּ שְׁפַטְיָ֑הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰὴλ καὶ Ζαχαρίας καὶ Μεισαὴλ καὶ Σαφατείας ·
traditions.VUL: Azaríam , et Iáhiel , et Zacharíam , et Azaríam , et Míchael , et Saphatíam :
traditions.KJV: Azariah , and Jehiel , and Zechariah , and Azariah , and Michael , and Shephatiah :

2.english_reference: all these [ were ] the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel

traditions.WLC: כָּל אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἰωσαφὰτ βασιλέως Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: omnes hi fílii Iósaphat regis Iuda .
traditions.KJV: all these [ were ] the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel .

3.english_reference: And their father gave them great gifts of silver , and of gold , and of precious things

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּ֣ן לָ הֶ֣ם אֲ֠בִי הֶם מַתָּנ֨וֹת רַבּ֜וֹת לְ כֶ֤סֶף וּ לְ זָהָב֙ וּ לְ מִגְדָּנ֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῶν δόματα πολλά , ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον καὶ ὅπλα
traditions.VUL: Dedítque eis pater suus multa múnera argénti , et auri , et pensitatiónes ,
traditions.KJV: And their father gave them great gifts of silver , and of gold , and of precious things ,

traditions.WLC: עִם עָרֵ֥י מְצֻר֖וֹת בִּֽ יהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: μετὰ πόλεων τετειχισμένων ἐν Ἰούδᾳ ·
traditions.VUL: cum civitátibus munitíssimis in Iuda :
traditions.KJV: with fenced cities in Judah :

3.english_reference: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הַ מַּמְלָכָ֛ה נָתַ֥ן לִֽ יהוֹרָ֖ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν βασιλείαν ἔδωκεν τῷ Ἰωράμ ,
traditions.VUL: regnum autem trádidit Ioram ,
traditions.KJV: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram ;

traditions.WLC: כִּי ה֥וּא הַ בְּכֽוֹר
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὗτος πρωτότοκος .
traditions.VUL: eo quod esset primogénitus .
traditions.KJV: because he [ was ] the firstborn .

4.english_reference: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨קָם יְהוֹרָ֜ם עַל מַמְלֶ֤כַת אָבִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστη Ἰωρὰμ ἐπὶ τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Surréxit ergo Ioram super regnum patris sui :
traditions.KJV: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father ,

traditions.WLC: ו֙ וַ יִּתְחַזַּ֔ק
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκραταιώθη ,
traditions.VUL: cumque se confirmásset ,
traditions.KJV: he strengthened himself ,

4.english_reference: and slew all his brethren with the sword

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּהֲרֹ֥ג אֶת כָּל אֶחָ֖י ו בֶּ חָ֑רֶב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ
traditions.VUL: occídit omnes fratres suos gládio ,
traditions.KJV: and slew all his brethren with the sword ,

4.english_reference: and [ divers ] also of the princes of Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֖ם מִ שָּׂרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀρχόντων Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: et quosdam de princípibus Israel .
traditions.KJV: and [ divers ] also of the princes of Israel .

5.english_reference: Jehoram [ was ] thirty and two years old when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ שְׁתַּ֛יִם שָׁנָ֖ה יְהוֹרָ֣ם בְּ מָלְכ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὄντος αὐτοῦ τριάκοντα καὶ δύο ἐτῶν , κατέστη Ἰωρὰμ ἐπὶ τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Trigínta duórum annórum erat Ioram cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: Jehoram [ was ] thirty and two years old when he began to reign ,

5.english_reference: and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁמוֹנֶ֣ה שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὀκτὼ ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: et octo annis regnávit in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem .

6.english_reference: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֜לֶךְ בְּ דֶ֣רֶךְ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδῷ βασιλέως Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Ambulavítque in viis regum Israel ,
traditions.KJV: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel ,

6.english_reference: like as did the house of Ahab

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἐποίησεν οἶκος Ἀχαάβ ,
traditions.VUL: sicut égerat domus Achab :
traditions.KJV: like as did the house of Ahab :

6.english_reference: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י בַּת אַחְאָ֔ב הָ֥יְתָה לּ֖ וֹ אִשָּׁ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι θυγάτηρ Ἀχαὰβ ἦν αὐτοῦ γυνή ,
traditions.VUL: fília quippe Achab erat uxor eius ,
traditions.KJV: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife :

6.english_reference: and he wrought [ that which was ] evil in the eyes of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ רַ֖ע בְּ עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐναντίον Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: et fecit malum in conspéctu Dómini .
traditions.KJV: and he wrought [ that which was ] evil in the eyes of the LORD .

7.english_reference: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא אָבָ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה לְ הַשְׁחִית֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֔יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐβούλετο Κύριος ἐξολεθρεῦσαι τὸν οἶκον Δαυείδ ,
traditions.VUL: Nóluit autem Dóminus dispérdere domum David
traditions.KJV: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David ,

7.english_reference: because of the covenant that he had made with David

traditions.WLC: לְמַ֣עַן הַ בְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת לְ דָוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: διὰ τὴν διαθήκην ἣν διέθετο τῷ Δαυείδ ,
traditions.VUL: propter pactum , quod iníerat cum eo :
traditions.KJV: because of the covenant that he had made with David ,

7.english_reference: and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever

traditions.WLC: וְ כַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֗ר לָ תֵ֨ת ל֥ וֹ נִ֛יר וּ לְ בָנָ֖י ו כָּל הַ יָּמִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὡς εἶπεν αὐτῷ δοῦναι αὐτῷ λύχνον καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας .
traditions.VUL: et quia promíserat ut daret ei lucérnam , et fíliis eius omni témpore .
traditions.KJV: and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever .

8.english_reference: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah

traditions.WLC: בְּ יָמָי ו֙ פָּשַׁ֣ע אֱד֔וֹם מִ תַּ֖חַת יַד יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἀπέστη Ἐδὼμ ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: In diébus illis rebellávit Edom , ne esset súbditus Iudæ ,
traditions.KJV: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּמְלִ֥יכוּ עֲלֵי הֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβασίλευσαν ἐφ᾽ αὑτοὺς βασιλέα .
traditions.VUL: et constítuit sibi regem .
traditions.KJV: and made themselves a king .

9.english_reference: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes , and all his chariots with him

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּֽעֲבֹ֤ר יְהוֹרָם֙ עִם שָׂרָ֔י ו וְ כָל הָ רֶ֖כֶב עִמּ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾤχετο Ἰωρὰμ μετὰ τῶν ἀρχόντων , καὶ πᾶσα ἡ ἵππος μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Cumque transísset Ioram cum princípibus suis , et cuncto equitátu , qui erat secum ,
traditions.KJV: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes , and all his chariots with him :

9.english_reference: and he rose up by night

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִי֙ קָ֣ם לַ֔יְלָה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο καὶ ἠγέρθη νυκτός ,
traditions.VUL: surréxit nocte ,
traditions.KJV: and he rose up by night ,

9.english_reference: and smote the Edomites which compassed him in , and the captains of the chariots

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֗ךְ אֶת אֱדוֹם֙ הַ סּוֹבֵ֣ב אֵלָ֔י ו וְ אֵ֖ת שָׂרֵ֥י הָ רָֽכֶב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν Ἐδὼμ τὸν κυκλοῦντα αὐτὸν καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῶν ἁρμάτων ,
traditions.VUL: et percússit Edom , qui se circumdéderat , et omnes duces equitátus eius .
traditions.KJV: and smote the Edomites which compassed him in , and the captains of the chariots .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔφυγεν ὁ λαὸς εἰς τὰ σκηνώματα αὐτῶν .

10.english_reference: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּפְשַׁ֨ע אֱד֜וֹם מִ תַּ֣חַת יַד יְהוּדָ֗ה עַ֚ד הַ יּ֣וֹם הַ זֶּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστη ἀπὸ Ἰούδα Ἐδὼμ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης ·
traditions.VUL: Attamen rebellávit Edom , ne esset sub ditióne Iuda usque ad hanc diem :
traditions.KJV: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day .

10.english_reference: The same time [ also ] did Libnah revolt from under his hand

traditions.WLC: אָ֣ז תִּפְשַׁ֥ע לִבְנָ֛ה בָּ עֵ֥ת הַ הִ֖יא מִ תַּ֣חַת יָד֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: τότε ἀπέστη Λομνὰ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἀπὸ χειρὸς αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: eo témpore et Lobna recéssit ne esset sub manu illíus .
traditions.KJV: The same time [ also ] did Libnah revolt from under his hand ;

10.english_reference: because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י עָזַ֔ב אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐνκατέλιπεν Κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: Derelíquerat enim Dóminum Deum patrum suórum :
traditions.KJV: because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers .

11.english_reference: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah

traditions.WLC: גַּם ה֥וּא עָשָֽׂה בָמ֖וֹת בְּ הָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γὰρ αὐτὸς ἐποίησεν ὑψηλὰ ἐν πόλεσιν Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: ínsuper et excélsa fabricátus est in úrbibus Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah ,

11.english_reference: and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּ֨זֶן֙ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσαν τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: et fornicári fecit habitatóres Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּדַּ֖ח אֶת יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπεπλάνησεν τὸν Ἰουδά .
traditions.VUL: et prævaricári Iudam .
traditions.KJV: and compelled Judah [ thereto ] .

12.english_reference: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֤א אֵלָי ו֙ מִכְתָּ֔ב מֵֽ אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַ נָּבִ֖יא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν αὐτῷ ἐν γραφῇ παρὰ Ἠλειοὺ τοῦ προφήτου
traditions.VUL: Allátæ sunt autem ei lítteræ ab Elía prophéta ,
traditions.KJV: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet ,

12.english_reference: saying , Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֑ר כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: λέγων Τάδε λέγει Κύριος θεὸς πατρός σου Δαυείδ
traditions.VUL: in quibus scriptum erat : Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus David patris tui :
traditions.KJV: saying , Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father ,

12.english_reference: Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father

traditions.WLC: תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא הָלַ֨כְתָּ֙ בְּ דַרְכֵי֙ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט אָבִ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: Ἀνθ᾽ ὧν οὐκ ἐπορεύθης ἐν ὁδῷ Ἰωσαφὰτ τοῦ πατρός σου
traditions.VUL: Quóniam non ambulásti in viis Iósaphat patris tui ,
traditions.KJV: Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father ,

12.english_reference: nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ דַרְכֵ֖י אָסָ֥א מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν ὁδοῖς Ἀσὰ βασιλέως Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: et in viis Asa regis Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah ,

13.english_reference: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ תֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ דֶ֨רֶךְ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθης ἐν ὁδοῖς βασιλέως Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: sed incessísti per iter regum Israel ,
traditions.KJV: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel ,

13.english_reference: and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּזְנֶ֤ה אֶת יְהוּדָה֙ וְ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσας τὸν Ἰούδαν καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: et fornicári fecísti Iudam , et habitatóres Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring ,

13.english_reference: like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab

traditions.WLC: כְּ הַזְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἐξεπόρνευσεν οἶκος Ἀχαάβ ,
traditions.VUL: imitátus fornicatiónem domus Achab ,
traditions.KJV: like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab ,

13.english_reference: and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father ’s house , [ which were ] better than thyself

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֨ם אֶת אַחֶ֧י ךָ בֵית אָבִ֛י ךָ הַ טּוֹבִ֥ים מִמְּ ךָ֖ הָרָֽגְתָּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου υἱοὺς πατρός σου τοὺς ἀγαθοὺς ὑπὲρ σὲ ἀπέκτεινας ·
traditions.VUL: ínsuper et fratres tuos , domum patris tui , melióres te , occidísti :
traditions.KJV: and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father ’s house , [ which were ] better than thyself :

14.english_reference: Behold , with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה נֹגֵ֛ף מַגֵּפָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה בְּ עַמֶּ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ Κύριος πατάξει σε πληγὴν μεγάλην ἐν τῷ λαῷ σου
traditions.VUL: ecce Dóminus percútiet te plaga magna cum pópulo tuo ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people ,
